WITH pair_counts AS (
  SELECT
    t.tradekind AS trader_type,
    a.translink,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS a
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink
  JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
  GROUP BY t.tradekind, a.translink
), pair_shares AS (
  SELECT
    trader_type,
    translink,
    record_count,
    record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY trader_type) AS share
  FROM pair_counts
), pair_averages AS (
  SELECT
    trader_type,
    translink,
    record_count,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY trader_type) AS average_share
  FROM pair_shares
)
SELECT
  trader_type,
  AVG(record_count) AS average_record_count,
  AVG(share) AS average_share,
  AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM pair_averages
WHERE share >= average_share
GROUP BY trader_type;

assumptions.assumption: “Total count of all pairs” means the sum of record counts across transaction pairs for the same trader type; the average share is the unweighted average across those pairs.
